privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: NEXBODY is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or use our services.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: We may collect personal information such as your name, email address, company name, and phone number when you submit an inquiry through our contact form.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use the information we collect to respond to your inquiries, provide demonstrations of our products, and communicate with you about our services.

sections.title: 3. Data Security
sections.body: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

sections.title: 4. Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at {{contactEmail}}.

sections.title: Basic website analytics
sections.body: We collect basic first-party statistics by default to understand website use, including page paths, referral domains, non-personal campaign tags, broad device categories and interaction counts. We do not set analytics visitor-identification cookies, use browser fingerprinting, identify unique visitors, reconstruct cross-page journeys, or join these statistics with form contents or contact details. Event IDs only prevent duplicate delivery of the same event and are not visitor IDs. Successful inquiries are counted independently after our email service accepts them, without visitor or campaign attribution. Use Disable basic analytics in the footer to opt out; the setting is stored locally in your browser and can be reversed there. Existing analytics refusals, Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control remain respected. Old analytics session cookies are cleared. Anonymous event records are retained for up to 90 days and daily totals for up to 365 days. A short-lived, rotating IP-derived rate-limit key protects the collection endpoint; raw IP addresses are not stored in our analytics database. Our hosting and email providers may separately process technical or inquiry data as described elsewhere in this policy. For questions, contact {{contactEmail}}.
